answers.core: The keywords highlight feature is core, and this would just be something to add on top of that and should not be in a plugin.
answers.workaround: There isn't really a way to do this in the editor, as far as I know. There does exist plugins that do fully-fledged to-do lists in Godot but that's not the same thing: my issue is that a feature that is already implemented in the engine (highlighting keywords like TODO) seems a bit hollow and would need more to it for it to be actually useful.

title: Add an indicator of TODO comments in the code editor
